rules.name: ^(php(54|56|70|71|72|73|74|80|81|82|83)-)?php(-[a-z0-9_-]+)?$
rules.note: Remi stopped building for CentOS 7 in June 2024, so every Remi EL7 build predates the fix.

yum -y install https://extras.getpagespeed.com/release-latest.rpm
yum-config-manager --enable getpagespeed-extras-php84
yum install php84-getpagespeed-stack

yum -y install https://extras.getpagespeed.com/release-latest.rpm
yum --enablerepo=getpagespeed-extras-php54 upgrade php 'php-*'
systemctl restart httpd php-fpm

rules.name: ^(php\d\.\d|libapache2-mod-php\d\.\d)(-[a-z0-9_-]+)?$
rules.note: Free to install; commercial production use requires GetPageSpeed Ultra, or GetPageSpeed Fleet for servers that host client websites.
rules.fix:
wget https://extras.getpagespeed.com/release-latest.deb
sudo apt install ./release-latest.deb
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade 'php{branch}-*'
sudo systemctl restart php{branch}-fpm

rules.name: ^(php\d(\.\d)?|libapache2-mod-php\d(\.\d)?)(-[a-z0-9_-]+)?$
rules.note: Ubuntu backports the fix and keeps the original PHP version number.
rules.fix:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install --only-upgrade $(dpkg -l 'php*' | awk '/^ii/{print $2}')
sudo systemctl restart 'php*-fpm.service' apache2
